items.title: 13.10.2 Garam aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.10.2, printed page 300.

blocks.text: Garam aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath chlorine sodium chloride aur sodium chlorate(V), NaClO3, banati hai, ek aur disproportionation: 3Cl2(g) + 6NaOH(aq) se 5NaCl(aq) + NaClO3(aq) + 3H2O(l). Chlorine Cl2 mein 0, NaCl mein -1 aur NaClO3 mein +5 hai: woh NaClO3 mein 0 se +5 tak oxidise aur NaCl mein 0 se -1 tak reduce hoti hai. Reaction dikhata hai ke darja hararat products par kaise asar dalta hai aur redox reactions mein chlorine kitni har-fan-maula hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne garam NaOH wala muadla 3Cl2 + 6NaOH se NaCl + NaClO3 + 3H2O chhapa hai, jo balanced nahi (baen 6 Cl, daen sirf 2). Sahi muadla 3Cl2 + 6NaOH se 5NaCl + NaClO3 + 3H2O hai: paanch Cl atoms -1 tak reduce aur ek +5 tak oxidise hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Chlorine ke thande dilute aur garam ghaliz NaOH ke saath balanced muadle likhein, aur oxidation states se wazeh karein ke dono disproportionations kyun hain (exercise Q.2o, p).
blocks.explanation: Thanda: Cl2 + 2NaOH se NaCl + NaClO + H2O; Cl 0 se -1 aur 0 se +1 jati hai. Garam: 3Cl2 + 6NaOH se 5NaCl + NaClO3 + 3H2O; Cl 0 se -1 (paanch atoms) aur 0 se +5 (ek atom, jo woh paanch electrons khota hai jo baqi lete hain). Har soorat mein akeli chlorine oxidise aur reduce dono hoti hai, to dono disproportionations hain; garam, taqatwar alkali oxidation ko chlorate(V) tak aage dhakelti hai.

items: Garam NaOH: 3Cl2 + 6NaOH se 5NaCl + NaClO3 + 3H2O; Cl 0 se -1 (reduced) aur 0 se +5 (oxidised); darja hararat chlorate(I) ya chlorate(V) tay karta hai.
